reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message, and I didn't record the 8 April date anywhere.

I couldn't confirm the date. None of the shared files I can open have a Brackenwater Freight Co. account folder, contract or CRM record, and nobody in #central-team has posted a renewal date for them. In the reply I said I'd treat it as hearsay. I suggested checking the signed contract or order form, or asking whoever owns the account, and offered to put a renewal reminder on the calendar once someone confirms it.

I didn't use `search_messages` or read anything outside what Pree can see herself. A renewal date is an operational fact about the account, not a finance figure, so posting it on the team channel needed no approval.
